snippet.title: Story of Huntsman Against Darkness
snippet.description:
Huntsman Against Darkness launches on Steam June 25.

Survive corrupted hordes, free villagers, and rebuild your village in this dark fantasy roguelite. #bulletheaven #bullethell #darkfantasygame #singleplayergame #gameplay #indiegame 

Wishlist now:
https://bit.ly/huntsmanAD?utm_source=yt-videos

Launch Sale: 40% off from June 25 to July 9.
